goal: Populate the PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB field when creating or updating PSBTs
Allow stateless hardware wallets and coordinators to verify multisig policies and change paths
agreement: Concept approval after author fixed duplicate xpub decode errors and derived keys directly (fametrano)
Prior objections to multisig-only scope and interface design addressed by author (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes hardware wallet failures and removes manual coordinator workarounds
Stateless signers like BitBox02 and Trezor reject or misread multisig PSBTs missing this field
